title: NEXORA Server
description: One VLESS endpoint: transport parameters plus a reference to its credentials. A Server is NOT an OmegaPac profile and MUST NOT be stored under a '+' envelope key (docs/architecture/24, ADR-0012). Credentials never appear as values here -- every secret field is a keystore reference (ADR-0010, ADR-0011).

id.description: Stable identity; the envelope key is derived as -nexora.server.<id>.

displayName.description: User-visible label. MUST NOT be used as an identifier: rename must not break ConnectorProfile references.

protocol.description: Only VLESS is modelled in NEXORA. Other protocols stay expressible as legacy FixedProfile/PacProfile and are out of scope for this schema (ADR-0003).

address.description: DNS name, IPv4 or IPv6 literal. No userinfo, no scheme, no port.

port.description: Remote port on address. Unrelated to the loopback inbound port, which the Connector assigns (docs/architecture/27).

userIdRef.description: Reference to the VLESS user/UUID secret. The value lives in the Connector keystore only.

network.description: Transport. Determines which transport block below is required.

security.description: Transport security. 'reality' is REALITY (requires publicKey); 'tls' requires the tls block.

flow.description: XTLS flow. Constrained below: vision is legal only over tcp with tls or reality.

tls.description: TLS parameters. Required exactly when security is 'tls', forbidden when it is 'none' or 'reality' (allOf below).

reality.description: REALITY parameters. Required exactly when security is 'reality'; a server cannot carry both tls and reality.

ws.description: WebSocket transport parameters, required when network is 'ws'.

grpc.description: gRPC transport parameters, required when network is 'grpc'. REALITY is not defined over gRPC, so the allOf below rejects that pair.

xhttp.description: XHTTP transport parameters, required when network is 'xhttp'.

h2.description: HTTP/2 transport parameters, required when network is 'h2'; h2 mandates TLS.

tag.description: Derived Xray outbound tag. Not free text, so two servers can never collide on a tag.

notes.description: Free-text user note. Never rendered into a log line or a diagnostics dump without masking, because users paste endpoints into notes.

source.description: Provenance. Drives whether a refresh may replace this server and whether deleting the subscription cascades; a server with no provenance cannot be safely garbage-collected.

subscriptionId.description: Set when source is 'subscription'; drives '404 does not delete' policy (docs/architecture/29).

createdAt.description: Set once by the extension when the Server is created; never rewritten by a subscription refresh, or the UI cannot tell a new server from a replaced one.

updatedAt.description: Last mutation of transport parameters. The Compiler compares it against the applied config mtime to decide whether a config.apply is needed.

headersRef.description: Header maps may carry Authorization/Cookie, so they are keystore references, never inline objects. This is the SEC-1 fix expressed as a schema.

fingerprint.description: ClientHello fingerprint (e.g. chrome, firefox, safari). Not a secret.

insecure.description: Certificate verification is never disabled in a NEXORA-generated config.

publicKey.description: Curve25519 public key, x25519 base64url. The counterpart PRIVATE key is rejected by additionalProperties:false -- a client config must never contain it (docs/architecture/32).

headersKeys.description: The header names the stored object behind headersRef holds. The materializer resolves headersRef to the stored map and fills exactly these keys; the masking layer enumerates them from the model rather than from the store, because a key list the store cannot know in advance is a masking rule it cannot enforce (ODEC-45).

allOf.description: Vision flow is only meaningful over raw TCP with TLS or REALITY. A compiler that accepted vision-over-ws/xhttp would emit an Xray config that silently ignores flow, i.e. a server the user believes is protected by XTLS that is not. Reject instead (docs/architecture/23).
